sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, sitting top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, host Alsager Town on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. The league leaders arrive on the back of an impressive run: a win in their most recent outing followed by a draw and four consecutive wins before that. They face Alsager Town, who are struggling near the foot of the table with just 4 points from 10 games and winless in their last five matches, making this a strong opportunity for Sandbach to extend their commanding position.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town, two points behind Sandbach with 20 points, travel to Dawley Town on Saturday looking to maintain the pressure on the leaders; Stafford's recent form shows a draw most recently followed by a win, suggesting steady momentum. AFC Bridgnorth, third with 19 points, host Eccleshall in a mid-table battle where both sides are in reasonable form—Bridgnorth have won five of their last six, while Eccleshall recovered from a recent loss with a win. Wolverhampton Casuals, also on 19 points, visit Wednesfield Community, another fixture between sides separated by table position but with similar recent performances. Bilston Town (fifth, 17 points) entertain Foley Meir in a clash of mid-table clubs, while Barnton, fourth from bottom with 15 points, host Shawbury United, who have lost five of their last six and sit in the bottom four. Brereton Social welcome Widnes Town, the division's basement club with just 2 points and on a five-game losing run; Brereton themselves have won most recently but remain in the bottom half. Market Drayton Town, 10th with 12 points, travel to face New Mills in the division, while Cheadle Heath Nomads visit Telford Town in a contest between two of the weakest-performing sides, and Crewe host Allscott Heath as both battle near the lower reaches of the table.
